scope: Add app-side leaderboard notification hooks and deploy preference registration. No leaderboard sender or rank trigger activated.

behavior.default: Off; first-session permission enrollment still enables practice only.
behavior.leaderboard_only: Retains APNs token without enrolling in the practice schedule.
behavior.guest: Can save the setting; a future leaderboard sender must require a bound, eligible signed-in account.
behavior.sign_out: The next registration removes account binding while preserving local preference.
behavior.account_deletion: Disables both remote preferences and clears the server token.
behavior.permission_revocation: Clears both effective server opt-ins and the token while retaining the local choices.
behavior.routing: Default action on leaderboard-update opens the existing leaderboard; training-invite and daily-practice continue to open juggling setup.
behavior.active_work: Pending notification navigation waits for recording, replay, import or other presented screens to close. It never starts a recording.
behavior.already_open: Consumes a duplicate leaderboard destination if the leaderboard is already presented.

future_recipient_requirements: user_id bound to an eligible leaderboard profile

alert.title: Your leaderboard position changed
alert.body: Someone moved ahead of you. Tap to see the leaderboard.

backend_contract.unsupported_actions: Unknown categories and dismissal do not navigate.

Leaderboard delivery records and sender, using a separate collapse identifier from practice alerts
backend_contract.old_client_behavior: Legacy registration signatures still work. A newer legacy request clears unsupported leaderboard capability; an older revision cannot overwrite a newer preference.

deployment.live_rpc_tests: Passed assertions in rolled-back transaction: leaderboard-only retains token without practice; stale opt-in cannot overwrite opt-out; authenticated callers lack direct RPC privilege.
deployment.cleanup: The one newly generated disabled installation used for HTTP verification was removed. Rolled-back RPC fixture left no data. Existing installation retained.

ios_ui_tests.scope: Local OS notification fixtures exercise the real category, delegate and root navigation; no APNs provider delivery in these UI checks.

validation.postgresql: Full isolated scripts/test-account-backend.sh passed; reran legacy push and schedule suites after new migration, plus new leaderboard hook assertions.
validation.initial_ui_attempts: The simulator first expanded/hinted side swipe without executing the default action. SpringBoard logged: Hinting side swipe instead of executing action. After using the system Open action, the app opened welcome because OS launch does not inherit the old XCTest skip-welcome argument. The tests now complete welcome through the real UI before the cold launch. Production routing was not changed to bypass either behavior.
validation.initial_result_bundle: Xcode stalled collecting diagnostics after all tests finished; owned process stopped. Unit results retained in text log. Subsequent UI runs disable verbose failure diagnostics.
validation.localization: String catalog parses and includes both new strings in all five supported languages.

Offline opt-outs/sign-outs reach the server on the next successful sync.
